packages.title: Dubai Extravaganza: Skyline & Desert Dunes Luxury
packages.subtitle: Burj Khalifa At The Top, Premium 4x4 Desert Safari & Marina Dhow Cruise
packages.overview: Experience the glitz, glamour, and futuristic allure of Dubai with The TraveloPedia. From ascending the iconic Burj Khalifa to enjoying high-octane dune bashing and dining under Arabian stars in the desert, this itinerary blends ultra-modern marvels with rich Bedouin traditions.
highlights: Burj Khalifa 124th & 125th Floor Observatory Entry with panoramic sunset views
Luxury Red Dune Desert Safari with BBQ Dinner, Tanoura Dance & Fire Show
Glass-enclosed Dhow Dinner Cruise along Dubai Marina with live acoustic music
Half-day Dubai City Tour covering Dubai Frame, Palm Jumeirah & Gold Souk
Visit to Dubai Mall, Fountain Show, and Museum of the Future photo stop
Luxury 4-Star / 5-Star Hotel Stay with daily gourmet breakfast buffet
inclusions: 5 Nights luxury accommodation in Dubai at 4-Star / 5-Star Hotel
Daily lavish buffet breakfast at the hotel
Burj Khalifa Non-Prime Slot ticket with observatory access
Desert Safari in 4x4 Land Cruiser with BBQ Dinner & cultural shows
Marina Dhow Cruise with international buffet dinner
Dubai Frame entry ticket
Private airport pick-up & drop-off in air-conditioned luxury vehicle
UAE Tourist Visa & OK To Board processing fees included
24/7 dedicated Surat concierge support
exclusions: International roundtrip airfare (available at lowest group rates on request)
Tourism Dirham Fee payable directly at the hotel (approx. AED 15-20 per night)
Personal expenses, mini-bar, laundry, and telephone calls
Any meals not mentioned in the inclusions
Optional travel insurance (strongly recommended)

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai & Marina Dhow Cruise
itinerary.description: Touch down at Dubai International Airport. Meet our courteous chauffeur who will transfer you in a private luxury vehicle to your hotel. Settle in, refresh, and get ready for an enchanting evening on a glass-bottomed Dhow Cruise along the gleaming Dubai Marina canal.
itinerary.hotel: Millennium Place Marina / Grand Excelsior Hotel (4-Star Superior)

itinerary.title: Dubai City Tour, Dubai Frame & Museum of the Future
itinerary.description: After a hearty breakfast, embark on a curated city tour. Gaze up at the iconic Dubai Frame offering split views of Old Dubai and New Dubai. Drive past the opulent Burj Al Arab, explore the Spice and Gold Souks, and stop for photographs outside the stunning calligraphy facade of the Museum of the Future.
activities: Museum of the Future Photo Stop

itinerary.title: Burj Khalifa 124th Floor & Dubai Mall Fountain Show
itinerary.description: Spend your morning exploring the world’s largest retail paradise, The Dubai Mall. In the afternoon, ascend the world’s tallest tower to the 124th & 125th floor observation deck for breathtaking 360-degree vistas. In the evening, witness the synchronized Dubai Fountain water dance at the base of the tower.

itinerary.title: Luxury 4x4 Red Dunes Desert Safari & Bedouin Camp
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely morning shopping or swimming. By mid-afternoon, our 4x4 Land Cruiser will pick you up for thrilling dune bashing across the Lahbab red dunes. Experience sandboarding, camel rides, henna painting, and feast on a lavish barbecue dinner under the desert sky accompanied by fire dancers and belly dance performances.

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure or Optional Abu Dhabi Day Excursion
itinerary.description: Keep this day relaxed for shopping at Mall of the Emirates or take an optional excursion to Abu Dhabi to witness the grand Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, BAPS Hindu Mandir Abu Dhabi, and Ferrari World.
activities: Free day for luxury shopping or Abu Dhabi Grand Mosque tour

itinerary.title: Fond Farewell & Departure to Surat/India
itinerary.description: Savor your final lavish breakfast in Dubai. Complete hotel check-out and enjoy some last-minute duty-free shopping before our private chauffeur escorts you to Dubai International Airport for your flight back home.

packages.title: Enchanting Bali: Ubud Rainforest & Private Pool Villa
packages.subtitle: Nusa Penida Island Tour, Tegalalang Rice Terraces, Bali Swing & Waterfalls
packages.overview: Discover the Island of the Gods with a curated journey split between the tranquil arts and rice terraces of Ubud and the vibrant coastal luxury of Seminyak. Indulge in private pool villa stays, exotic Balinese massages, and the jaw-dropping cliffs of Nusa Penida.
highlights: 2 Nights in Ubud Forest Resort + 4 Nights in Luxury Seminyak Private Pool Villa
Full Day Speedboat Excursion to Nusa Penida (Kelingking Beach, Broken Beach, Angel’s Billabong)
Iconic Aloha Ubud Jungle Swing & Tegalalang Rice Terrace walk
Uluwatu Sunset Temple Cliff tour with Kecak Fire Dance performance
Tegenungan Waterfall and Kintamani Volcano scenic overlook
Complimentary Romantic Candlelight Dinner for couples & 60-min Balinese Spa massage
inclusions: 6 Nights accommodation (4-Star Deluxe Resort + Private Pool Villa)
Daily breakfast including 1 Signature Floating Breakfast in your private pool
Speedboat transfers and private island car tour for Nusa Penida
All sightseeing entries, temple sarongs, and jungle swing tickets
Private air-conditioned car with English-speaking local guide/driver
Airport pick-up and drop-off transfers
1 Romantic Candlelight Dinner setup
exclusions: International flights to Denpasar (DPS)
Indonesia Visa on Arrival (approx. USD 35 / IDR 500,000 paid at airport)
Bali Tourist Levy (approx. IDR 150,000)
Personal expenses, water sports at Tanjung Benoa (available add-on)

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bali & Transfer to Ubud
itinerary.description: Arrive at Ngurah Rai International Airport in Denpasar. Receive a traditional frangipani flower garland welcome from our chauffeur and transfer directly into the emerald heart of Ubud. Check into your tropical resort and relax.
itinerary.hotel: The Payogan Villa Resort & Spa Ubud (4-Star Deluxe)

itinerary.title: Kintamani Volcano, Coffee Plantation & Tegalalang Swing
itinerary.description: Journey to Mount Batur viewpoint at Kintamani for panoramic volcanic scenery. Taste authentic Luwak coffee at a traditional spice plantation. Later, soar over the emerald canyon on the famous Ubud swing and stroll the UNESCO-listed Tegalalang terraces.

itinerary.title: Tegenungan Waterfall & Check-in to Private Pool Villa
itinerary.description: Visit the rushing cascades of Tegenungan Waterfall. In the afternoon, transfer to the coastal town of Seminyak / Kuta and step into your private luxury pool villa complete with personalized amenities.
itinerary.hotel: The Kayana Seminyak / Aksari Villa Seminyak (Private Pool Villa)

itinerary.title: Nusa Penida Island Tour by Speedboat
itinerary.description: Early morning speedboat to the rugged paradise of Nusa Penida. Marvel at the T-Rex shaped cliff of Kelingking Secret Point, the natural rock arch of Broken Beach, and the crystal infinity pool of Angel’s Billabong. Savor beachfront lunch before returning to Bali.

itinerary.title: Uluwatu Cliff Temple & Sunset Kecak Fire Dance
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure to enjoy your private plunge pool and floating breakfast. In late afternoon, visit the dramatic Uluwatu Temple perched 70 meters above the crashing Indian Ocean. Witness the captivating Kecak Fire Dance as the sun melts into the ocean.

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure & Authentic 60-Minute Balinese Spa
itinerary.description: Unwind with an authentic 60-minute Balinese Aromatherapy massage. Spend the afternoon exploring Seminyak’s chic boutiques, beach clubs like Potato Head, or taking a stroll down Double Six Beach.
activities: Beach Club Sunset or Boutique Shopping

itinerary.title: Farewell Bali & Return Home
itinerary.description: Enjoy a relaxed breakfast, pack fond memories and handcrafted souvenirs, and transfer to Denpasar Airport for your return flight to India.

packages.title: Swiss Alps & Romantic Paris: Grand European Odyssey
packages.subtitle: Mount Titlis Rotair, Zurich, Lucerne, Eiffel Tower 2nd Tier & Seine River Cruise
packages.overview: Our flagship luxury European vacation brings together the pristine alpine majesty of Central Switzerland with the timeless elegance of the French capital. Curated with Swiss rail passes, luxury coach tours, 4-Star city-center hotels, and authentic Indian/Continental dining options.
highlights: Mount Titlis Cable Car with World’s First Revolving Rotair & Cliff Walk suspension bridge
Lucerne city tour with Chapel Bridge, Lion Monument & Lake Lucerne Boat Cruise
High-speed TGV Train journey from Zurich/Basel across the French countryside to Paris
Eiffel Tower 2nd Floor Priority Access with breathtaking 360-degree Paris panorama
Romantic Seine River Glass-Topped Cruise passing Notre Dame & Louvre Museum
Illuminated Paris Night City Tour passing Champs-Élysées, Arc de Triomphe & Place de la Concorde
Indian Meals option available with Gujarati & Jain dietary accommodations
inclusions: 4 Nights in Zurich / Engelberg / Lucerne Area (4-Star Hotel)
3 Nights in Paris (4-Star Central Hotel)
Daily hot breakfast buffet at all hotels
Mount Titlis Cable Car + Ice Flyer + Cliff Walk entry ticket
High-Speed TGV Train ticket (2nd Class Reserved) from Switzerland to Paris
Eiffel Tower 2nd Level Entry Ticket
1-Hour Seine River Cruise ticket
All luxury coach sightseeing transfers as per itinerary
Schengen Visa guidance and biometric appointment scheduling from Surat
exclusions: International roundtrip airfare
Schengen Visa embassy fee & VFS service charges
Overseas travel insurance
City tourist taxes payable directly to hotels (approx. €3-€6 per person per night)

itinerary.title: Arrival in Zurich & Transfer to Central Switzerland
itinerary.description: Arrive at Zurich Kloten Airport. Transfer to your luxury Swiss hotel. Spend the evening walking around Lake Zurich and exploring the historic Bahnhofstrasse luxury shopping boulevard.

itinerary.title: Mount Titlis Snow Mountain & Lucerne City Tour
itinerary.description: Ascend to 10,000 feet on the world’s first revolving cable car, Titlis Rotair. Experience eternal snow, the Glacier Cave, and the daring Cliff Walk. In the afternoon, descend to charming Lucerne to view the Chapel Bridge and the weeping Lion Monument.

itinerary.title: Interlaken, Jungfraujoch Excursion (Optional) & Lake Brienz
itinerary.description: Explore the scenic town of Interlaken tucked between Lake Thun and Lake Brienz. Optional full-day excursion to Jungfraujoch - Top of Europe via the high-tech Eiger Express tricable gondola.

itinerary.title: Rhine Falls Boat Ride & TGV High Speed Train to Paris
itinerary.description: Witness Europe’s most powerful waterfall, the Rhine Falls at Schaffhausen. In the afternoon, board the high-speed TGV train darting into France. Arrive in the romantic City of Lights, Paris, and check in to your hotel.
itinerary.hotel: Novotel Paris Centre Tour Eiffel / Mercure Paris (4-Star)

itinerary.title: Eiffel Tower 2nd Tier, Seine Cruise & Paris Highlights
itinerary.description: Ascend to the 2nd Floor of the Eiffel Tower for commanding perspectives over Paris. Embark on a glass-canopied Seine River cruise gliding beneath historic stone bridges. Complete the day with a panoramic drive past the Arc de Triomphe and Champs-Élysées.

itinerary.title: Disneyland Paris Magic Day (or Louvre & Montmartre)
itinerary.description: Full day of thrilling fantasy and fun at Disneyland Paris (1-Park / 2-Park pass) or take a cultural deep-dive into the Louvre Museum to witness the Mona Lisa followed by the bohemian artist square of Montmartre and Sacré-Cœur basilica.
activities: Disneyland Paris or Louvre Museum Excursion

itinerary.title: Palace of Versailles & Luxury Department Store Shopping
itinerary.description: Visit the opulent royal Palace of Versailles and its gilded Hall of Mirrors. In the afternoon, explore Galeries Lafayette Haussmann for premier European perfume and fashion shopping.

itinerary.title: Au Revoir Paris & Homeward Bound
itinerary.description: Enjoy a final French croissant and café au lait. Chauffeur transfer to Charles de Gaulle Airport for your flight back to India with a heart full of European memories.

packages.bestTimeToVisit: May to October & December for Christmas

packages.title: Paradise on Earth: Kashmir Valley & Gulmarg Gondola
packages.subtitle: Srinagar Luxury Houseboat, Gulmarg Phase 1 Gondola, Pahalgam Valley & Sonmarg
packages.overview: Dubbed "Heaven on Earth", Kashmir enchants with snow-capped Pir Panjal peaks, shimmering Dal Lake shikaras, blossoming Mughal gardens, and cedar-scented pine valleys in Pahalgam. Includes a stay in a handcrafted luxury cedarwood houseboat.
highlights: 1 Night in Luxury Handcrafted Cedar Houseboat on Dal Lake + 4 Nights Premium Hotel
Gulmarg Gondola Ride (Phase 1 guaranteed cable car ride to Kongdoori)
Scenic Shikara boat ride on Dal Lake visiting floating vegetable markets and Char Chinar
Pahalgam Lidder Valley excursion visiting Betaab Valley, Aru Valley & Chandanwari
Mughal Gardens of Srinagar: Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh & Chashme Shahi
Pure Vegetarian & Jain food options available with warm Kashmiri hospitality
inclusions: 5 Nights accommodation (1 Night Dal Lake Houseboat + 2N Srinagar + 2N Pahalgam)
Daily breakfast and dinner (MAP Meal Plan)
All transfers and sightseeing by dedicated private non-AC Innova / Crysta vehicle
1-Hour Shikara ride on Dal Lake
Gulmarg Gondola Phase 1 Cable Car tickets included
Toll taxes, parking, driver allowances included
exclusions: Airfare to/from Srinagar (SXR)
Pony rides, sledges, and snow activities
Local union vehicle for Betaab / Aru Valley in Pahalgam (as per state regulations)
Personal tips and laundry

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar & Dal Lake Shikara Ride
itinerary.description: Arrive at Srinagar Sheikh-ul-Alam Airport. Greet your private driver and transfer to Dal Lake. Check into a traditional carved cedar houseboat. In the golden evening light, embark on a tranquil Shikara ride across the lotus-dappled waters.
itinerary.hotel: Wangnoo Heritage Luxury Houseboat Dal Lake

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Gulmarg: Meadow of Flowers & Gondola
itinerary.description: Drive through weeping willow avenues to Gulmarg. Board the famous Gulmarg Gondola, one of the world’s highest cable cars, up to Kongdoori meadow at 10,000 feet. Enjoy breathtaking views of Apharwat peak and roll in snow.
itinerary.hotel: The Grand Mumtaz Resorts / Kolahoi Green Srinagar

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Pahalgam: Valley of Shepherds
itinerary.description: Depart for the tranquil valley of Pahalgam. En route, pass the fragrant saffron fields of Pampore and historic Avantipur ruins. Follow the rushing emerald Lidder river. Check into your riverfront hotel and enjoy evening strolls along the pine forest trails.
itinerary.hotel: Hotel Heevan / Pine N Peak Pahalgam (4-Star)

itinerary.title: Pahalgam: Betaab Valley, Aru Valley & Chandanwari
itinerary.description: Spend the day soaking in the ethereal beauty of Betaab Valley (named after the Bollywood film), the quaint alpine village of Aru, and the starting point of Amarnath Yatra at Chandanwari.
itinerary.hotel: Hotel Heevan / Pine N Peak Pahalgam

itinerary.title: Mughal Gardens of Srinagar & Old City Handicrafts
itinerary.description: Return to Srinagar. Explore the terraced royal fountains and Chinar trees of Nishat Bagh (Garden of Bliss) and Shalimar Bagh (Abode of Love). Visit local artisans weaving authentic Pashmina shawls and hand-carving walnut wood furniture.

itinerary.title: Departure from Srinagar
itinerary.description: Relish a warm cup of Kashmiri Kahwa tea with crushed almonds and saffron. Chauffeur transfer to Srinagar Airport for your onward journey back to Gujarat.

packages.title: Royal Rajasthan: Palaces of Udaipur & Jaipur Forts
packages.subtitle: Lake Pichola Boat Cruise, Amber Fort Elephant Ride & Mehrangarh Jodhpur
packages.overview: Step into the glorious royal past of the Rajput maharajas. Stroll the romantic lakefront marble courtyards of Udaipur, the towering desert bastion of Jodhpur, and the Pink City of Jaipur with its honeycombed Hawa Mahal and formidable Amber Fort.
highlights: Private sunset boat ride on Lake Pichola overlooking Jag Mandir Palace
City Palace Udaipur and vintage car museum tour
Magnificent Mehrangarh Fort and Jaswant Thada royal cenotaph in Jodhpur
Amber Fort exploration with elephant/jeep ride up the ramparts
Photo stop at Hawa Mahal and visit to City Palace & Jantar Mantar observatory in Jaipur
Stay in heritage-style boutique hotels with authentic Rajasthani cultural shows
inclusions: 5 Nights in 4-Star Heritage boutique hotels (2N Udaipur, 1N Jodhpur, 2N Jaipur)
Daily breakfast and royal dinner buffet
Private AC Sedan / Ertiga vehicle for all inter-city transfers and local sightseeing
Lake Pichola boat cruise tickets
All toll taxes, interstate permits, parking fees, and driver allowances
exclusions: Monument entry tickets and camera fees
Lunch and beverages
Personal expenses and shopping

itinerary.title: Arrival in Udaipur: The City of Lakes
itinerary.description: Arrive in Udaipur. Check into your heritage hotel. In the evening, enjoy a sunset boat ride on Lake Pichola, taking in panoramic views of the Lake Palace and City Palace bathed in amber twilight.
itinerary.hotel: Fateh Garh Heritage Hotel / Chunda Palace (Heritage 4-Star)

itinerary.title: Udaipur City Palace & Saheliyon-ki-Bari
itinerary.description: Explore Udaipur’s City Palace complex with its peacock mosaics, mirrored galleries, and miniature paintings. Visit Jagdish Temple and the lush royal gardens of Saheliyon-ki-Bari with fountains sculpted from black marble.

itinerary.title: Udaipur to Jodhpur via Ranakpur Jain Temple
itinerary.description: Drive towards Jodhpur, stopping at the breathtaking 15th-century marble temple of Ranakpur featuring 1,444 uniquely carved marble pillars. Arrive in the Blue City of Jodhpur and explore the grand Mehrangarh Fort.
itinerary.hotel: Ajit Bhawan Palace / Indana Palace Jodhpur (Heritage 4-Star)

itinerary.title: Jodhpur to Jaipur: The Pink City
itinerary.description: Drive to the majestic state capital, Jaipur. Check into your hotel. Spend the evening browsing Johari Bazaar for blue pottery, lac bangles, and Jaipuri block-printed quilts.

itinerary.title: Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal & City Palace Jaipur
itinerary.description: Ascend the hillside battlements of Amber Fort. Visit the gleaming Sheesh Mahal (Mirror Palace). In the afternoon, marvel at the honeycomb windows of Hawa Mahal, the astronomy instruments of Jantar Mantar, and the City Palace museum.

itinerary.title: Departure from Jaipur
itinerary.description: After breakfast, complete check-out. Chauffeur transfer to Jaipur Airport or Railway Station for your return journey to Surat.

packages.title: Serene Kerala: Munnar Tea Hills & Alleppey Houseboat
packages.subtitle: Mattupetty Dam, Eravikulam National Park, Spice Plantations & Vembanad Lake Cruise
packages.overview: Unwind in "God’s Own Country". Breathe in crisp mountain air among Munnar’s emerald tea carpeted hills, experience aromatic spice plantations in Thekkady, and cruise the gentle palms and tranquil backwaters of Alleppey aboard a traditional thatched Kettuvallam houseboat.
highlights: 2 Nights in Munnar mist hills + 1 Night in Thekkady + 1 Night Alleppey Luxury Houseboat + 1N Cochin
Full Day Munnar sightseeing: Tea Museum, Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point & Kundala Lake
Guided Spice Plantation walk smelling fresh cardamom, cinnamon, and pepper vines
Exclusive Private AC Premium Houseboat cruise along backwaters with all meals prepared on board
Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary boat safari in Thekkady
Kathakali Classical Dance and Kalaripayattu Martial Arts live cultural show
inclusions: 5 Nights accommodation (4 Nights Premium Resorts + 1 Night Private Houseboat)
Daily breakfast & dinner at resorts, and All Meals (Lunch, Tea, Dinner, Breakfast) on Houseboat
Private air-conditioned car with seasoned English/Hindi speaking chauffeur
Guided spice plantation tour entry
All toll, parking, and driver allowances
exclusions: Airfare / Train tickets to Cochin (COK)
Periyar Lake boating tickets (online booking recommended)
Ayurvedic massage therapies (available at resort spas)

itinerary.title: Cochin to Munnar: Hill Station Ascent
itinerary.description: Arrive at Cochin Airport or Ernakulam Railway Station. Drive up through the Western Ghats to Munnar. En route, stop at Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls. Check into your tea garden resort.
itinerary.hotel: Blanket Hotel & Spa / Tea County Munnar (4-Star Deluxe)

itinerary.title: Munnar Tea Estates, Mattupetty & Eravikulam
itinerary.description: Visit Eravikulam National Park to spot the endangered Nilgiri Tahr mountain goat. Drive to Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, and Kundala Lake for pedal boating. Visit the Tata Tea Museum to learn the art of tea making.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady: Spices & Wildlife Sanctuary
itinerary.description: Drive past cardamom hills to Thekkady. Embark on a guided stroll through a local spice plantation. In the evening, watch a spellbinding Kathakali dance and Kalaripayattu martial arts performance.
itinerary.hotel: The Elephant Court / Poetree Sarovar Thekkady (4-Star)

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey: Luxury Backwater Houseboat Cruise
itinerary.description: Descend to Alleppey and board your private thatched-roof Kettuvallam houseboat by 12:30 PM. Cruise past paddy fields, rustic village canals, and coconut groves while enjoying freshly prepared Kerala delicacies.
itinerary.meals: Breakfast, Authentic Kerala Lunch, Evening Tea, Dinner
itinerary.hotel: Lakes & Lagoons Private Deluxe Houseboat Alleppey

itinerary.title: Alleppey to Cochin: Colonial Fort Kochi Heritage
itinerary.description: Disembark after breakfast and drive to Cochin. Tour Fort Kochi, Chinese Fishing Nets, St. Francis Church, and Jew Town with the Paradesi Synagogue. Indulge in some evening shopping at LuLu Mall.

itinerary.title: Departure from Cochin
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and transfer to Cochin International Airport for your journey back home.

packages.title: Vietnam Discovery: Hanoi, Ha Long Bay Cruise & Da Nang
packages.subtitle: Overnight 5-Star Ha Long Bay Cruise, Ba Na Hills Golden Hands Bridge & Hoi An Lanterns
packages.destination: Hanoi, Ha Long Bay & Da Nang, Vietnam
packages.overview: From the timeless charm of Hanoi’s French Quarter to cruising emerald waters among limestone karsts on a 5-star Ha Long Bay luxury vessel, walking the world-famous Golden Bridge held aloft by colossal stone hands in Ba Na Hills, and releasing floating lanterns in Hoi An.
highlights: 1 Night Overnight 5-Star Luxury Cruise on Ha Long Bay with private balcony cabin
Walk across the world-famous Golden Bridge held by giant stone hands at Ba Na Hills
Cable car ride at Sun World Ba Na Hills and French Village exploration
Hoi An Ancient Town lantern boat ride and night street market
Hanoi Old Quarter Cyclo ride, Hoan Kiem Lake, and Train Street photo spot
All local transfers, domestic flight from Hanoi to Da Nang included
inclusions: 6 Nights accommodation (5 Nights 4-Star/5-Star hotels + 1 Night 5-Star Cruise Cabin)
Domestic Flight Ticket: Hanoi to Da Nang with check-in luggage
Daily breakfast and all meals on Ha Long Bay cruise
Ba Na Hills Cable Car + Golden Bridge entrance ticket
Private air-conditioned touring coaches
English speaking licensed tour guide
Vietnam E-Visa assistance
exclusions: International flights to Hanoi / from Da Nang
Vietnam E-Visa government fee ($25)
Beverages and personal expenses

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi: Capital City Heritage
itinerary.description: Arrive at Noi Bai International Airport in Hanoi. Private transfer to your hotel. Stroll through the historic 36 Guild Streets of the Old Quarter and take photos along the picturesque Hoan Kiem Lake.
itinerary.hotel: The Q Hotel / Grand Mercure Hanoi (4-Star Superior)

itinerary.title: Hanoi to Ha Long Bay: Boarding the 5-Star Luxury Cruise
itinerary.description: Drive through Red River Delta to Ha Long Bay. Embark on a luxury 5-star cruise. Sail through thousands of limestone pinnacles rising dramatically from emerald waters. Enjoy kayaking in hidden caves and sunset cocktails on the sundeck.
itinerary.hotel: Doris Cruise / Mon Chéri 5-Star Luxury Cruise (Balcony Cabin)

itinerary.title: Ha Long Bay Tai Chi & Flight to Da Nang
itinerary.description: Greet the sunrise with a peaceful Tai Chi session on the open sundeck. Visit Sung Sot (Surprise) Cave. Brunch on board before disembarking and transferring to Hanoi airport for a short flight to coastal Da Nang.
itinerary.hotel: Four Points by Sheraton / TMS Hotel Da Nang Beach (5-Star)

itinerary.title: Ba Na Hills & The Iconic Golden Hands Bridge
itinerary.description: Board the world’s longest single-wire cable car to Sun World Ba Na Hills. Walk across the stunning Golden Bridge held by giant moss-covered hands in the clouds. Explore the French Village and Fantasy Park.
itinerary.meals: Breakfast, Buffet Lunch at Ba Na Hills
itinerary.hotel: Four Points by Sheraton Da Nang (5-Star)

itinerary.title: Marble Mountains & Enchanting Hoi An Ancient Town
itinerary.description: Visit the limestone peaks and sacred caverns of Marble Mountains. In the afternoon, head to UNESCO-heritage Hoi An. Stroll among yellow-hued merchant houses and release glowing paper lanterns onto the Thu Bon River.
itinerary.hotel: Four Points by Sheraton Da Nang

itinerary.title: Day at Leisure on My Khe Beach or Shopping
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely day relaxing at the rooftop infinity pool, sunbathing on Forbes-voted My Khe Beach, or shopping for tailored silk clothing and Vietnamese coffee.
itinerary.hotel: Four Points by Sheraton Da Nang
activities: Optional Coconut Boat Tour in Cam Thanh

itinerary.title: Farewell Vietnam & Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy a rich Vietnamese drip coffee with condensed milk. Transfer to Da Nang International Airport for your flight back home.

packages.title: Himachal Wonderland: Manali Snow Peaks & Shimla Heritage
packages.subtitle: Solang Valley Adventure, Atal Tunnel, Rohtang Snow Point & Shimla Mall Road
packages.overview: Escape to the snow-crowned Himalayas. Wander the colonial ridge of British summer capital Shimla, drive through the engineering feat of Atal Tunnel to Lahaul valley, and experience paragliding, skiing, and hot sulphur springs in Manali.
highlights: 2 Nights Shimla + 3 Nights Manali + 1 Night Chandigarh in 4-Star scenic resorts
Atal Tunnel drive to Sissu Lahaul Valley and Solang Valley snow adventure arena
Shimla Ridge, Christ Church, Scandal Point & Kufri amusement park
Hadimba Devi Temple, Vashisht Hot Springs & Old Manali riverfront cafes
Scenic riverside drive along Beas River and visit to Kullu Shawl weaving factories
Pure Vegetarian & Gujarati / Jain meal options provided on request
inclusions: 6 Nights accommodation in premium 4-Star resorts
Daily breakfast and hot buffet dinner
Dedicated AC vehicle from Delhi / Chandigarh pickup to drop-off
Atal Tunnel and Solang Valley sightseeing
All toll taxes, state road taxes, parking, and driver fees
exclusions: Airfare or train ticket to Delhi/Chandigarh
Rohtang Pass permit and local union taxi (if visited, subject to NGT permission)
Adventure activities (paragliding, zorbing, river rafting)
Personal expenses

itinerary.title: Chandigarh / Delhi to Shimla: The Queen of Hills
itinerary.description: Meet our chauffeur in Chandigarh or Delhi. Drive through winding pine hills up to Shimla (altitude 2,200m). Check into your resort with valley views. Spend the evening strolling on the pedestrian Mall Road.

itinerary.title: Shimla: Kufri Snow Point & Heritage Ridge
itinerary.description: Drive to Kufri for horse rides, yak rides, and views of cedar forests. In the afternoon, explore the Neo-Gothic Christ Church, Scandal Point, and Gaiety Theatre along Shimla’s iconic Ridge.

itinerary.title: Shimla to Manali via Kullu Valley & Pandoh Dam
itinerary.description: A breathtaking 8-hour drive alongside the turquoise Beas River. Stop at Pandoh Dam, Hanogi Mata Temple, and a traditional Kullu Shawl weaving emporium. Arrive in Manali and check in.
itinerary.hotel: The Himalayan Resort & Spa / Manuallaya Manali (4-Star)

itinerary.title: Solang Valley, Atal Tunnel & Sissu Lahaul
itinerary.description: Pass through the 9.02km engineering marvel Atal Tunnel at 10,000 feet, emerging into the dramatic dry alpine terrain of Sissu Waterfall in Lahaul Valley. Return to Solang Valley for thrilling adventures.

itinerary.title: Manali Local: Hadimba Temple, Vashisht & Jogini Falls
itinerary.description: Visit the 450-year-old wooden pagoda Hadimba Devi Temple enveloped by giant deodar trees. Bathe in natural sulfur hot springs at Vashisht and walk to the cascading Jogini Waterfalls.

itinerary.title: Manali to Chandigarh: Garden City
itinerary.description: Descend through Kullu valley with an optional river rafting stop at River Beas. Continue driving to the modern planned city of Chandigarh. Check in and relax.

itinerary.title: Rock Garden & Departure
itinerary.description: Visit Nek Chand’s famous Rock Garden and tranquil Sukhna Lake before transferring to Chandigarh Airport / Railway Station for your flight/train back to Surat.

packages.bestTimeToVisit: Throughout the year (Snow in Dec-Feb, Pleasant in Mar-June)

packages.title: Greece & Santorini Caldera: Aegean Romance & Sunset Domes
packages.subtitle: Private Oia Caldera Cave Villa, Sunset Catamaran Cruise & Athens Acropolis VIP
packages.overview: Immerse yourself in postcard-perfect Aegean luxury with The TraveloPedia. Marvel at the whitewashed cliffside villages of Oia, delve into ancient history at the Acropolis of Athens, sail across volcanic hot springs on a private luxury catamaran, and relax in a private caldera plunge pool suite.
highlights: 4 Nights in Santorini at a 5-Star Caldera Cliffside Cave Suite with private plunge pool
3 Nights in Athens at a Luxury Boutique Hotel overlooking the illuminated Acropolis
Exclusive Sunset Sailing Catamaran Cruise with Greek BBQ, local wines & volcano snorkeling
Private guided VIP walking tour through Oia, Fira & Megalochori traditional villages
Acropolis & Parthenon skip-the-line private archaeologist guided tour
Special pure vegetarian & Jain friendly Greek culinary arrangements throughout
High-speed ferry transfer between Athens (Piraeus) and Santorini with VIP lounge seats
inclusions: 7 Nights luxury 5-star hotel & caldera cave suite accommodation
Daily champagne & gourmet breakfast with Aegean caldera panoramic views
Private luxury catamaran sunset cruise with fresh meals and drinks
VIP Acropolis private tour with all museum and archaeological site permits
High-speed business class ferry tickets (Athens - Santorini - Athens)
All airport, port, and excursion transfers in private air-conditioned Mercedes fleet
Schengen Visa assistance & comprehensive documentation service by Surat travel desk
24/7 dedicated WhatsApp concierge monitoring throughout the Greece tour
exclusions: International flight tickets (can be arranged via Emirates/Qatar/Lufthansa on request)
Schengen Visa embassy submission fee (paid directly at VFS)
Greek Climate Resilience Tax payable directly to hotels (approx. €7-10/night)
Personal expenses, tips, and optional helicopter island transfers

itinerary.title: Arrival in Athens & Historic Plaka Evening
itinerary.description: Arrive at Athens International Airport (Eleftherios Venizelos). Meet your private chauffeur and transfer to your 5-star hotel in central Athens. In the evening, enjoy a leisurely stroll through the historic cobblestone alleys of Plaka under the illuminated Acropolis.
itinerary.hotel: Electra Metropolis Hotel Athens / NJV Athens Plaza (5-Star)

itinerary.title: Acropolis VIP Archaeological Tour
itinerary.description: Embark on a private VIP guided exploration of the legendary Acropolis, Parthenon, Temple of Athena Nike, and the world-class Acropolis Museum. Afternoon at leisure for designer shopping along Ermou Street.

itinerary.title: High-Speed Ferry to Santorini & Caldera Suite Check-in
itinerary.description: Board the premium high-speed ferry across the azure Aegean Sea to Santorini. Arrive at Athinios Port and transfer up the dramatic cliffs to your whitewashed cliffside cave suite in Oia. Enjoy your private heated plunge pool overlooking the volcanic caldera.
itinerary.hotel: Andronis Luxury Suites / Canaves Oia Suites (5-Star Caldera)

itinerary.title: Santorini Sunset Sailing Catamaran Cruise
itinerary.description: Board a luxury catamaran for a semi-private sailing cruise across the caldera. Swim near the volcanic hot springs and Red Beach, snorkel in crystal clear waters, and watch the world-famous golden sunset over Oia from the open deck with Greek Mediterranean dining.
itinerary.hotel: Andronis Luxury Suites / Canaves Oia Suites (5-Star Caldera)

itinerary.title: Oia Blue Domes Photo Tour & Wine/Juice Tasting
itinerary.description: Early morning private photo walk around the iconic three blue domes of Oia before the crowds arrive. Afternoon visit to traditional Megalochori village and a cliffside estate for sunset juice/wine tasting overlooking the volcanic rim.
itinerary.hotel: Andronis Luxury Suites / Canaves Oia Suites (5-Star Caldera)

itinerary.title: Leisure Day: Black Sand Beach & Private Yachting
itinerary.description: Spend a tranquil day at Perivolos Black Sand Beach with reserved luxury cabanas, or indulge in a private caldera massage treatment at the hotel spa. In the evening, dine at a cliffside fine dining restaurant.
itinerary.hotel: Andronis Luxury Suites / Canaves Oia Suites (5-Star Caldera)

itinerary.title: Return Ferry to Athens & Farewell Aegean Evening
itinerary.description: Transfer to Santorini Port for your high-speed ferry back to Athens. Check in to your hotel and enjoy a panoramic rooftop dinner overlooking Syntagma Square.

itinerary.title: Departure from Athens with Unforgettable Memories
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast and some final souvenir shopping. Private chauffeur transfer to Athens International Airport for your departure flight back home to Surat.
